drive_scope.name: Husky Satellite Lab
drive_scope.method: Known exact document IDs; one verified Subsystem Testing folder listing; no broad/global search or write actions
drive_scope.test_folder_listing: Nine direct children; current and older ADCS procedures read, unrelated subsystem files not opened.

decision.reason: Documented coil-off intent and competing manager rates do not constrain actual current/field decay, sensor acquisition/filter age, driver electrical envelope or full event timing. No qualifying completed hardware measurements were located.
decision.current_candidate_scope: Three-actuator topology, raw VN-100 magnetic-data intent, qualitative coil-off sampling, conditional vendor component capabilities and EPS rail-monitor design facts only; no numerical flight-cycle timing adopted.

minimum_missing_inputs.input: Released installed BOM/part revisions, PCB/schematic and coil/sensor-to-body positions, matrices and positive-current polarity; disposition of COTS versus in-house and MT01A versus MT01.

Driver part/mode and pin truth table, actual rails/winding voltage, current limiting or feedback, configured carrier/burst parameters; measured per-axis m(I,T), current/power, saturation and safe thermal/duty envelope.

VN-100 variant/interface/register packet and filter/output settings, internal magnetic acquisition epoch/aperture, raw data producer and delivery latency/freshness policy; external sensor inventory if any.

Approved magnetic-error/cleanliness threshold plus synchronized current and field-versus-time after representative/worst-case bursts at installed geometry; measured valid quiet/settling window including filter recovery.

Approved 5/10 Hz rate-group/control/cycle mapping; trace of acquisition, compute, command latch and physical current on/off under flight firmware, including clock offset, worst-case queue latency and jitter.

recommended_parametric_sweeps.candidates: 5 and 10 Hz are competing documented design assumptions.
recommended_parametric_sweeps.constraint: First distinguish rate-group tick from raw acquisition and full burst-cycle period. Current distinct-phase 0.1 s-grid implementation has minimum whole cycle 0.4 s.

recommended_parametric_sweeps.candidates: Historical 80% PDR and 50/20/10% mode-budget values can be labeled sensitivity anchors; Phase 6A 40% remains TEST-ONLY.
recommended_parametric_sweeps.constraint: Vary feasible burst/period pairs; separate carrier PWM duty. No proposed setting is declared thermally/electrically flight-admissible.

recommended_parametric_sweeps.candidates: Sample-to-compute and compute-to-actuation delay/jitter versus burst/period; explicit synthetic assumptions only.
recommended_parametric_sweeps.constraint: No measured numerical range available; do not silently adopt diagnostic 0.1 s delays or serial allocation as measured delays.

recommended_parametric_sweeps.candidates: Software gate and acquisition-age sensitivity; hardware-valid range pending current/field/filter measurements.
recommended_parametric_sweeps.constraint: The present ideal sensor cannot predict contamination validity. Do not invent a physical decay constant, aperture or cleanliness magnitude.

recommended_parametric_sweeps.candidates: Separate conditional CR0002+MT01A, older MT01 and in-house evidence branches; vary effective duty and calibrated gain/limits once bounded.
recommended_parametric_sweeps.constraint: Never mix mismatched voltage/dipole/resistance endpoints into a claimed real actuator; keep uncalibrated sensitivity explicitly ASSUMED.

recommended_parametric_sweeps.candidates: Separate documented 3 degree knowledge bounds and tighter budget allocations as labeled scenarios.
recommended_parametric_sweeps.constraint: No measured mounting/error distribution or known body mapping; sweeps do not certify actual geometry.

dominant_uncertainties.quantity: Delivered torque and usable actuation duty
dominant_uncertainties.effect: Unknown actual air-coil/driver dipole, gain, current and thermal limits directly change available magnetic torque and average control authority.
Unmeasured local residual field/remanence, coil decay and sensor filtering can corrupt sampled B even when the simulation has zero commanded dipole.

dominant_uncertainties.quantity: Sample age, cadence and burst phase
dominant_uncertainties.effect: Long/variable delay and held commands change the relationship of measured B/rate to actuation; 5/10 Hz manager labels alone do not constrain this.
Incorrect coil/sensor transforms or sign can redirect torque and invalidate the controller's field/command relationship.

status_definitions.CONFIRMED: The named evidence establishes the scoped statement, not installed acceptance or compliance.
status_definitions.TBR: Explicit source review flag remains open.
status_definitions.TBC: Conflicting or uncertain applicability/selection requires confirmation.
status_definitions.TBD: No supported definition/value/measurement in reviewed evidence.
status_definitions.ASSUMED: Budget, software, analytical or unverified prediction; not measured flight input.

treatment_definitions.USE AS CURRENT CANDIDATE: Retain only the row's explicitly limited design/specification fact for candidate reasoning; not authorization to activate a timing profile.
treatment_definitions.KEEP TEST-ONLY: Regression or diagnostic use only; preserve provenance and do not promote to hardware evidence.
treatment_definitions.PARAMETRIC SWEEP: Future labeled sensitivity study; no simulation executed or physical admissibility established in this phase.
treatment_definitions.BLOCKED PENDING HARDWARE INPUT: Need the specified team/hardware disposition or measurement before assigning a flight value.
treatment_definitions.NOT MODELED YET: No supported model parameters; retain omission explicitly rather than inventing effects.
